retrievalProfile.description: A melancholic double-exposure composition featuring a large, faded portrait overlaid with a silhouette of a bridge and a full-body figure standing by water.
excludeWhen: vibrant high-contrast pop art is requested
minimalist flat vector illustrations are needed
modern sans-serif bold typography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered photographic composition dominated by a cool blue and desaturated palette. It features a large, semi-transparent male portrait in the upper right, bisected by the dark silhouette of a bridge. In the lower left, a smaller full-body figure stands on a shoreline overlooking shimmering water, creating a sense of scale and introspection.
coreVisualRelationships: Large faded portrait as the atmospheric background layer
Dark horizontal bridge silhouette acting as a compositional divider
Small full-body figure providing a focal point for scale
Water surface in the foreground reflecting light and color
coreInvariants: Cool blue color cast across the entire image
Soft, low-contrast blending between photographic layers
Wide-spaced serif typography for names and titles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large portrait occupies the top two-thirds; small figure is positioned in the bottom-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, diagonal line of the bridge silhouette anchoring the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large face down the bridge line to the small figure, then across the water to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky and water areas provide breathing room for the layered elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted steel blue and cyan tones in the water and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal and deep navy in the bridge and clothing silhouettes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft white highlights on the water surface and skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, leaning towards mid-tones and highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif with high stroke contrast.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single serif family used in different weights and scales for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Soft drop shadows for legibility over complex backgrounds

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif structure with high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a double exposure image with a large, faded male face in the upper right, a dark silhouette of a bridge crossing the middle, and a small figure standing by a shimmering blue lake in the bottom left. Apply a cool blue tint.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text in the top left (small, dark) and bottom right (large, white with wide tracking and soft shadow).

verificationChecks: Is the blue tint consistent across all layers?
Is the bridge silhouette clearly dividing the composition?
Is the text tracking wide enough to feel airy?
Is the double exposure effect soft and blended?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color cast
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth transitions between the face and the background
Ensure the bridge silhouette doesn't obscure the small figure
Verify the white text is readable against the water highlights
Confirm the overall mood remains melancholic and cool-toned
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered Portrait + Bridge Silhouette + Water Foreground + Wide-Tracked Serif Typography + Blue Monochromatic Tint
